primary_descriptive_contrasts.training: T=-6/+6 versus T=0 at driver=0, evaluation=0
primary_descriptive_contrasts.driver: driver=-6/+6 versus driver=0 at training=0, evaluation=0
primary_descriptive_contrasts.scorer: evaluation=-6/+6 versus evaluation=0 on the fixed training=0, driver=0 video

matched_driver_scorer_decomposition: For each training level and g=-6/+6, total = [C(T,g,0)-C(T,0,0)] + [C(T,g,g)-C(T,g,0)]; also report fixed-baseline-video scorer effect and interaction. Never compute a universal percentage attribution.
uncertainty_reporting: Retain all four identity differences and both seed differences, mean/range/direction counts. Exploratory n=4; clips and seeds are not additional independent identities. No population-significance claim.

plateau_check.endpoint: validation MSE with fixed 0 dB driver
plateau_check.semantics: Descriptive finite-budget plateau screen only; no early stopping, checkpoint selection, added epochs or proof of data sufficiency. Report train loss and all three driver validation curves.

interpretation_limits: SyncNet confidence is not perceptual lip-sync accuracy.
Report C, B, Dmin, D0 and offsets separately; C changes can include background-distance changes.
Matched drive+score effects include an interaction; fixed-video scorer changes do not measure altered mouth motion.
Geometry-qualified recording fallback limits generalization; retain all failed attempts.
Full official budget and a plateau screen do not establish that six minutes or four identities are sufficient for broader generalization.
